title: Recover the same run
when: Run waits, is interrupted or refuses target occupancy
need: Read the named holder, current stage and structured refusal. Observation-only runs can share an origin once every holder has only warm-up, QA or automatic settlement left. Open QA still blocks deploys. An eligible newer run on the same flow and target can take over a run waiting only on QA. A live driver owns re-entry. Recover the existing run using its printed command rather than duplicate it.
surface: Delivery rules opening and run records.
gap: Expose one recovery link from the human run page and agent result. Never export Yoke self-deploy db-admin authority as an ordinary project requirement.
